componentSpecs.name: ILeaveService
componentSpecs.description: Interface defining the leave service contract with 7 methods: createLeaveRequest(dto: CreateLeaveRequestDto): Promise<LeaveRequest>, approveLeave(id: string, approverId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, rejectLeave(id: string, rejecterId: string, reason: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, cancelLeave(id: string, cancellerId: string, reason: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, getLeaveRequestById(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>, getLeaveRequestsByEmployee(employeeId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>, getLeaveRequestsByStatus(status: LeaveStatus): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>. Defined in src/modules/leave/leave.service.interface.ts.

componentSpecs.name: LeaveService
componentSpecs.description: Implements ILeaveService. Injects ILeaveRepository via constructor. Business logic: validates date ranges (startDate before endDate, throws LeaveDomainError if invalid), enforces status transition rules (only PENDING → APPROVED/REJECTED, only APPROVED → CANCELLED, throws LeaveDomainError on invalid transitions), sets timestamps and actor IDs on transitions (approvedBy + approvedAt on approve, rejectedBy + rejectedAt + rejectionReason on reject, cancelledBy + cancelledAt + cancellationReason on cancel). All async errors caught per GP-006. Defined in src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts.
